user.title: Create a task list
user.description: Every list becomes a to-do entity (entity id: todo.tickoff_ followed by the list name). Tasks are stored in Home Assistant itself.

data_description.notify_service: Optional. Service used for due-date notifications of this list, e.g. mobile_app_my_phone.

error.name_required: Enter a name for the list.

abort.already_configured: A list with this name already exists.

init.title: List options

data_description.notify_service: Optional. Service used for due-date notifications of this list, e.g. mobile_app_my_phone.
data_description.notify_time: Time for due-date notifications of tasks without a time (default 08:00). Tasks with a time notify at that time.

init.description: Per list: the notify service for this list. On the Tickoff overview entry: the default service for all lists and the notification time.

add_task.name: Add task
add_task.description: Add a task with priority and tags to a Tickoff list.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Unknown tags are created in the global tag register.

recurrence.name: Recurrence
recurrence.description: type daily/weekly/monthly/yearly/after_completion, plus interval, weekdays (0=Monday) or days. null clears it.

subtasks.name: Subtasks
subtasks.description: Titles of subtasks to create with the task.

update_task.name: Update task
update_task.description: Change fields of a task; omitted fields stay as they are.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Unknown tags are created in the global tag register.

recurrence.name: Recurrence
recurrence.description: type daily/weekly/monthly/yearly/after_completion, plus interval, weekdays (0=Monday) or days. null clears it.

reopen_task.name: Reopen task
reopen_task.description: Mark a done task as open again.

get_tasks.name: Get tasks
get_tasks.description: Return the tasks of a list, optionally filtered.

set_tag.name: Set tag colour
set_tag.description: Create a tag or change its colour (global for all lists).

rename_tag.name: Rename tag
rename_tag.description: Rename a tag on every task in every list.

delete_tag.name: Delete tag
delete_tag.description: Delete a tag and remove it from every task.

get_tags.name: Get tags
get_tags.description: Return all tags with their colours.

snooze_task.name: Snooze task
snooze_task.description: Move the due date to tomorrow (the time is kept).

move_task.name: Move task
move_task.description: Place a task after another one (manual order); without previous task it goes first.

delete_completed.name: Delete completed tasks
delete_completed.description: Remove all done tasks from the list.

add_subtask.name: Add subtask
add_subtask.description: Add a subtask to a task.

update_subtask.name: Update subtask
update_subtask.description: Rename or tick a subtask. Ticking the last one completes the task.
